title: Templates for this module
body: Copy-ready structures you can reuse in your own engagements. Examples are fictional.

lines.label: Fields
lines.text: Decision requested, strategic problem, priority workflows, before/after, value/evidence, success criteria, dependencies, validation recommendation, sponsor decision, MAP

lines.label: Fictional example
lines.text: 8–10-minute capstone readout: why change, workflow evidence, value range, how to prove, decision and owners.

lines.label: Acceptance check
lines.text: No long product tour; directional claims labeled; sponsor decision explicit.
